scope: P21G spatial FV with actual P20D AABB solids and two compliant P18E-inspired uniform-exposed-face wall ports; no structural FEM or identified actual material. Linear harmonic one-volt RMS; omitted source face correction and exact CircularPores P21D model. Only wall-to-gas energy and reciprocity validated.
port_sense: source velocity Q=Sd*v positive inward; top/bottom wall flows Qj=-yj_dot, pressure from FV. Patches are entire exposed faces and assume uniform normal displacement; P18E Cw/F1 is not identified mode shape or boundary.
